blocking_findings: Trace references nonexistent X14-X39 and omits U00-U08; node command/schema bindings disagree.
Recovery and AP lanes use generic placeholder commands without executable fencing/bootstrap artifacts.
Mutations/assets and NEXT_SEMVER freeze are not exact or executable.
Negative effect checks are unreachable; stage scheduling and GO-capable independent closure are absent.
Every negative unconditionally rejects before effect assertions; no-op vectors falsely pass.
Four-party chains accept one key/role/identity and mismatched nonces.
Candidate, Vault, CNPG, proxy, activation, and recovery contracts are never validated.
Candidate signature verification and closure identity/hash policies are incomplete.
App-config/AppProject ownership remains broad and inconsistent with bootstrap-only claims.
Live activation is 0/32; prod access is unavailable and Argo auth expired.
DEV has two nodes, no Kata labels/runtime, and no N-1 evidence.
CNPG/Vault/TLS/network/backup/recovery and artifact/semver readiness are unproven.
23/24 no-op mutations still reject because effect assertions are unreachable.
Replay test is two readers of one static snapshot, not durable transactional state.
Positive mutation and FSM records fail declared schemas.
Expiry fields/tests are absent despite requirements, and per-requirement behavior is not validated.

consensus.summary: All lanes rejected v2.4 because negative effects are not measured, role and schema semantics are unenforced, trace/FSM/bootstrap/mutation mappings are invalid, closure is not GO-capable, and all live prerequisites remain absent.
